info.title: Brave 10
info.synopsis: La trama si svolge attorno all'incontro dell'eroe con la protagonista femminile, Isanami, giovane e graziosa sacerdotessa di Izumo sopravvissuta alla distruzione del suo santuario. Accortasi delle incredibili abilità  di Saizou, la ragazza ne richiede la protezione per essere scortata al casato di Sanada Yukimura, a cui il gran sacerdote, suo precettore, le ha intimato di chiedere aiuto. Saizou e Isanami si ritroveranno quindi a diventare due delle guardie del corpo di Sanada, e saranno protagonisti di un'avventura pericolosa e mortale, durante la quale incontreranno nuovi compagni, come il leggendario ninja Sarutobi Sasuke, e nemici inarrestabili come il famoso samurai Hattori Hanzo.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Isanami and Saizo continue their journey while the threat of assassins hangs over their heads. Saizo runs into Ana, a childhood friend, while she’s bathing, and they all go to the festival where Isanami has been invited to dance as the shrine maiden.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Saizou was able to prevent Ieyasu from taking Isanami, and Yukimura assigns Isanami and Saizo another team member on their trip to investigate Izumo.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Isanami and company arrive back at Izumo. They investigate the ruins, and despite Isanami’s best efforts to stay strong, she cracks and Saizou has to comfort her in his own gruff way. They discover a hidden passageway in the shrine, where Hanzo and Snake Lady ambush them.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Saizou struggles to come to terms with the fact that he was not strong enough to protect Isanami, and Kakei reports back to Yukimura on Isanami's abduction by Masamune Date.  Sasuke and Ana are sent to bring her back.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Yukimura invites all of his braves to the hot spring. When there Saizo, Sasuke, and Kamanosuke get in a fight with a monk named Seikai.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: A tea ceremony summoned all lords to the palace. Yukimura decides to travel with Rokuro, Saizo, and Isanami. On the road there they face many traps making Yukimura wish he brought more braves...

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Ieyasu has announced that Yukimura is to be executed on the spot if he does not surrender. Blocked by the sea and an army chasing him, help will come from a new warrior; One powerful enough to stop Seikai’s blows with one hand.

episodes.synopsis: After the long trip home, Saizo demands that Yukimura explain what his end game is. While Yukimura explains each warrior's role, the story takes an unexpected turn.

episodes.synopsis: Hanzo is alive and he has gathered the Five Iga Ninjas, a group trained to kill other ninjas. Can Yukimara's Brave warriors fight off these highly skilled killers or will Izanami-no-Mikoto finally be resurrected?
